title: For lovers of Olympism
author: cocobeor

title: Great
text:
For a very affordable price, you can enter this museum and enjoy a great experience. It’s highly interactive and packed with information about Olympic sports.
My favorite parts were the Formula 1 car, perfect for taking some great photos, and the interactive display showing all the Olympic torches, a real highlight.
Overall, it’s fun, informative, and well worth a visit. Highly recommended!
author: Vacation10059053694

title: Awesome to see!
text: If you love the Olympics, you’ll love this museum!  I personally am a big fan of the Olympics w my fav being the original Dream Team so this was a must see!
author: Colin_M

title: A must-do for sports lovers!
text: We didn't plan on doing this, but I'm extremely happy that we visited it after all. A very fun and interesting museum for very little money! The interactive section was also really fun, but my favourite part was the room with all the Olympic torches. I really recommend it if you're into sports!
author: ekivanassche

title: Very good surprise
text:
We came to protect ourselves from the outside heat.
What a nice surprise! 
We enjoyed this dive into the history of the modern Olympics with reminders of the 1992 Olympics. 
My 15 and 10 year olds loved it. 
Price more than correct!
author: audreyc359

title: Excellent Museum for any sports enthusiast
text:
Stumbled upon the Olympic museum by chance and so glad we did! 
Incredible range of exhibits across all sports and the history of the Olympic Games.
Highly recommend a visit for any sports enthusiast but you need to check opening times and days beforehand as with a number of other sights around Barcelona!
author: JasViljoen

title: Worth a visit
text: Really interesting. Spent a good hour here. Reasonably priced entry and had some great exhibits. Worth a visit if you are in the area
author: Nicola C

title: Very nice... a nice surprise!
text: Family visit with a boy aged 9 and 14. Everyone found something to be gained, from anecdotes to materials... a dive into the 1992 Barcelona Olympics, but not only with the history of the Jos since ancient times, the history of many sports and a beautiful collection of medals, cups and distinctions. A pleasant visit that even if it is not one of the must-see guides is worth the trip.
author: V408EJolivierb

title: Great!
text: Museum very complete, interactive and up to date, especially for the price! (3,50 € for students). Our visit lasted 1h30 which is more than satisfactory. I highly recommend.
